Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and ratified the financial statements audited by PwC Indonesia, granting a full discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners. The Board of Directors was authorized to submit these reports to the Ministry of Law.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of US$447,694,220 in net profit, with US$447,500,000 designated as cash dividends and US$194,220 as retained earnings. A final dividend of US$197,500,000 will be distributed following the previously paid interim dividend.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved the reappointment of KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto dan Rekan (PwC) and Public Accountant Firman Sababalat to audit the 2026 financial statements. The Board of Commissioners is authorized to replace the firm or accountant if necessary.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was granted the authority to determine the remuneration and allowances for both the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors for the 2026 fiscal year. This determination must take the company's financial condition into account.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved a capital reduction by retiring 589,195,200 treasury shares, resulting in a new total of 28,800,494,200 issued shares. The Board of Directors was authorized to take all necessary legal actions to implement this change.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved a share buyback of up to Rp5,000,000,000,000 in accordance with OJK Regulation No. 29/2023. The Board of Directors was granted authority to execute the buyback and appoint necessary parties.
Agenda #7: The meeting approved adjusting the Company's Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI) per BPS Regulation No. 7/2025. The Board of Directors is authorized to handle all legal formalities, including Notarial deeds and Ministry approvals.
